item.text: [{"task_id":"5ad8a7c0","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    foreground = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    endpoints = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    out = grid.copy()","    for r in range(grid.shape[0]):","        positions = np.where(grid[r] == foreground)[0]","        if len(positions) == endpoints and len(positions) > 1:","            left = int(positions[0])","            right = int(positions[-1])","            if np.all(grid[:, left + 1:right] == background):","                out[r, left:right + 1] = foreground","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[3]},"params":{"rule":[0,2,2]},"rationale":"Connect each horizontal pair of red endpoints when every column strictly between them contains only background throughout the input.
